summary: NeoVolta Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on May 27, 2026, for a firm commitment underwritten offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering price and specific share numbers are left blank in the draft. Proceeds, before expenses, will go to the company. The common stock trades on Nasdaq under NEOV at $2.76 per share as of May 26, 2026. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation triggers (e.g., acquisition, restructuring) are present.
